sentences.text: The applicable rule for a floating-rate loan granted for a non-business purpose to an individual and sanctioned on or after 2026-01-01 says a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. [E14,R2]
A current bank document says pre-payment or foreclosure attracts a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding. [E2,E3]

On the evidence provided, clause 7.4 does not comply with the applicable RBI direction because it provides for a pre-payment charge where the applicable direction says none may be levied. [E2,E3,E14,R2]

missing.searched: No exact text of Retail Loan Policy clause 7.4 was provided; only the Home Loan Agreement pre-payment charge wording was provided.
